description: AI-powered retail intelligence platform that combines retailer sales data with external market signals (seasonal trends, festivals, search volume, pricing trends) to generate short-term demand forecasts, similar product insights, and product-market fit analysis for small retailers in India
scope: MVP for hackathon - Category-level forecasting (7-15 days)
keyFeatures: External market signal integration (festivals, search trends, seasonality)
ML-based demand forecasting with confidence intervals
Inventory risk alerts (stockout, overstock, seasonal spikes)
